data.title: Rejection of Initial Home Furnishing Benefit (Erstausstattung der Wohnung)
data.summary: Jobcenter Beispielkreis rejected Tobias Beispiel's application of 03.03.2026 for a benefit to cover the initial furnishing of his apartment (Erstausstattung, § 24 Abs. 3 SGB II), because the requested washing machine and wardrobe are treated as replacement items rather than first-time furnishing. The letter suggests applying instead for a repayable loan under § 24 Abs. 1 SGB II.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter refused to pay for your washing machine and wardrobe as "initial furnishing" because it considers them replacements for items you already had, not items for a first-time household setup. As an alternative, you could apply for a loan (Darlehen) that you would have to pay back. If you disagree with the rejection, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Jobcenter by the deadline shown; it still counts as timely if it arrives at another German authority or social insurance provider before the deadline. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. If unsure, a Sozialberatung or lawyer can help.

key_facts.label: Decision
key_facts.quote: Ihr Antrag vom 03.03.2026 auf Leistungen für die Erstausstattung Ihrer Wohnung wird abgelehnt.

key_facts.label: Reason
key_facts.value: Items considered replacement procurement, not initial furnishing
key_facts.quote: Eine Erstausstattung liegt nicht vor, da die beantragten Gegenstände (Waschmaschine, Kleiderschrank) als Ersatzbeschaffung anzusehen sind.

key_facts.label: Alternative
key_facts.value: Loan under § 24 Abs. 1 SGB II can be requested
key_facts.quote: Hierfür kann ein Darlehen nach § 24 Abs. 1 SGB II beantragt werden.
